import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 礼盒分类处理器
 * 路由:
 *   /储物袋 礼盒 - 显示礼盒列表
 *   /储物袋 礼盒 2 - 显示礼盒第2页
 */

import { DEFAULT_PAGE, EMPTY_STRING, ZERO_VALUE as EMPTY_TOTAL, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_PAGE } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storage/newBag/lootboxes/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import { createPrimaryTabsBar } from '../tabs';
import { lootboxActions } from './capabilities';

/**
 * 解析命令参数
 */
const parseCommand = (msg: string): { page: number } => {
  const args = msg.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?(我的)?(储物袋|背包)\s+礼盒\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  if (!args) {
    return { page: DEFAULT_PAGE };
  }

  const parts = args.split(/\s+/);
  let page = DEFAULT_PAGE;

  if (parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX] && !isNaN(Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]))) {
    page = Math.max(MIN_PAGE, Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]));
  }

  return { page };
};

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const uid = e.uid as number;
    const { page } = parseCommand(e.MessageText ?? EMPTY_STRING);

    const result = await App({ bid: e.UserId, uid, page });

    if (result.code !== 'OK') {
      throw new Error('查询礼盒失败，请稍后重试');
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (result.data.total === EMPTY_TOTAL) {
      md.addText('暂无礼盒');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '礼盒', content: md, footer: createPrimaryTabsBar() }));

      return;
    }

    result.data.items.forEach(item => {
      const lootboxMd = Format.createMarkdown().addText(` 🎁 ${item.name} x${item.quantity}`);

      lootboxActions(item).forEach(action => {
        lootboxMd.addText(' ');
        lootboxMd.addButton(`[${action.label}]`, { data: action.command });
      });
      md.addBlockquote(lootboxMd);
      md.addNewline();
      if (item.description) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(` ${item.description}`));
      }
    });

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '礼盒',
        content: md,
        nav: {
          current: page,
          total: Math.ceil(result.data.total / result.data.pageSize),
          command: '/储物袋 礼盒 {page}'
        },
        footer: createPrimaryTabsBar()
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('礼盒分类处理失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询礼盒失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '礼盒', content: md, footer: createPrimaryTabsBar() }));
  }
});

export default response;
